# 静洞寻木素材

原创素材均使用内置 imagegen 生成，保存至当前目录后由本地页面加载。未使用外部模型加载服务。

## traveler.png

原始生成请求（透明背景）：

Create an original anime game character full-body standing portrait for a Chinese quiet mountain village joinery puzzle game. A young adult Chinese traveler, short dark slightly tousled hair, natural adult proportions, calm observant expression, angular confident facial contours, defined brow nose and jaw planes, handsome and approachable, NOT chibi, NOT photorealistic. Crisp hand-drawn dark outlines and controlled cel shading, sophisticated anime adventure art with tangible clothing texture, not soft airbrushed gradients. Muted slate-blue practical hiking jacket unzipped over plain ivory shirt, charcoal trousers, worn dark hiking shoes, small olive backpack with visible straps. Holding a small plain paper notebook casually in one hand, other arm relaxed. Three-quarter body facing slightly right. Whole body including feet, centered with generous transparent margin. Natural hands, anatomically correct. Soft cool skylight with subtle warm rimlight, restrained earthy colors. No text, no logos, no scenery, no weapons. Transparent background. This is a finished PNG cutout asset to display at entrance and completion of a serene cave puzzle, visual style compatible with a hard-lined anime elderly Chinese carpenter.

## rock.png

原始生成请求（不透明背景）：

Create a square seamless tileable hand-painted rock surface texture for a sophisticated anime exploration videogame. Orthographic flat material texture ONLY, no scene, no objects, no perspective, no text, no dramatic light. Quiet desaturated slate blue-gray sedimentary cave rock, broad irregular layered stone planes, very subtle muted sage mineral stains, fine tactile grain, sparse thin fissures, controlled painterly brushwork and crisp selective ink-like cracks. Low contrast, medium-dark overall, evenly lit diffuse albedo, NO baked cast shadows, NO highlights, NO 3D render of boulders, NO borders. Edges should tile seamlessly. Large stone strata that can wrap actual 3D cave wall geometry without appearing like a photo. Elegant restrained anime background painting craftsmanship, not cartoon cobblestone, not noisy photoreal gravel.

纹理使用世界坐标三向混合投射到真实三维岩壁。加载失败使用本地基础材质，仍可继续游戏。
